requirements.title: The package MUST expose a generic `SpecificationModel` envelope with stable identity, schema version, provenance, intent, evidence obligations, and a typed extension value. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-001)

requirements.title: Extension registration and compilation MUST be statically typed and explicit, and MUST NOT use `obj`, reflection discovery, or one platform-wide closed union. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-001)

requirements.title: Normalization MUST be deterministic, MUST canonicalize semantically unordered collections, and MUST produce a stable SHA-256 model fingerprint. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-002)
requirements.text: Normalization MUST be deterministic, MUST canonicalize semantically unordered collections, and MUST produce a stable SHA-256 model fingerprint. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-002)

requirements.title: The model codec MUST be explicitly versioned, deterministic, and round-trip losslessly for supported versions while refusing unsupported versions and following a documented unknown-field policy. (Stories: US-001, US-004; Acceptance: AC-002)
requirements.text: The model codec MUST be explicitly versioned, deterministic, and round-trip losslessly for supported versions while refusing unsupported versions and following a documented unknown-field policy. (Stories: US-001, US-004; Acceptance: AC-002)

requirements.title: Semantic diff MUST distinguish equivalent and changed models, ignore authoring-only noise, and report stable semantic paths plus before/after fingerprints. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-003)
requirements.text: Semantic diff MUST distinguish equivalent and changed models, ignore authoring-only noise, and report stable semantic paths plus before/after fingerprints. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-003)

requirements.title: The requirements extension MUST represent user value, scope, requirements, acceptance criteria, ambiguity/decision state, and evidence obligations with stable typed identifiers and references. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-004)
requirements.text: The requirements extension MUST represent user value, scope, requirements, acceptance criteria, ambiguity/decision state, and evidence obligations with stable typed identifiers and references. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-004)

requirements.title: Compiler validation MUST report all detectable duplicate, missing, malformed, unresolved-reference, and extension errors in deterministic order with stable codes and paths. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-004)
requirements.text: Compiler validation MUST report all detectable duplicate, missing, malformed, unresolved-reference, and extension errors in deterministic order with stable codes and paths. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-004)

requirements.title: Legacy Markdown migration MUST return only `Migrated`, `Ambiguous`, or `Unsupported`; every non-migrated result MUST carry a typed reason and source location, and analysis MUST perform no canonical-source write. (Stories: US-003; Acceptance: AC-005)

requirements.title: Projection validation MUST distinguish missing, malformed, unreadable, stale-source, direct-edit/generated-fingerprint, and unsupported-version failures with actionable stable codes. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-006)
